questions.explanation:
渗透作用的发生取决于半透膜的存在以及膜两侧的浓度差。在植物生理学中，成熟植物细胞的原生质层充当了选择透过性膜的角色，将细胞液与外界溶液隔开。当土壤中化肥浓度过高，导致土壤溶液的水势低于根系细胞液的水势时，水分会顺着水势梯度从细胞内向细胞外流失。这种水分的逆向迁移不仅会导致细胞失水萎蔫，还会破坏细胞膜的结构完整性，干扰正常的代谢活动，从而在宏观上表现为植株的生理性干旱，即所谓的“烧苗”现象。

动物细胞与植物细胞在渗透吸水行为上的差异，本质上源于细胞结构对渗透压耐受力的不同。红细胞仅由一层极薄的细胞膜包裹，其机械强度极低，无法抵御因大量水分进入而产生的流体静压力。相比之下，植物细胞壁主要由纤维素和果胶组成，具有显著的刚性和极小的伸缩性。当植物细胞吸水时，原生质体会对细胞壁产生向外的压力，即膨压，而细胞壁则产生方向相反的抗张力。当这两种力量达到动态平衡时，水分进出达到平衡，从而保护了细胞不至于因过度吸水而解体，这种机制也是维持草本植物挺拔状态的关键。

科学施肥的核心在于维持根际环境的渗透平衡与养分供应的持续性。从生物学角度看，根系对矿质元素的吸收是一个主动运输过程，需要消耗能量且受载体蛋白限制，而水分吸收则主要依赖渗透作用。傍晚灌溉能有效降低土壤温度，减少水分蒸发，使土壤溶液维持在较低的渗透压水平，确保植物在夜间能够通过根压作用恢复水分平衡。提倡“薄肥勤施”则是为了将土壤溶液浓度控制在植物受体可承受的生理阈值之内，既避免了高浓度盐分对根系的渗透损伤，又通过增加施肥频率确保了养分供应与作物生长节律的精准匹配，从而实现增产增效。
questions.question_en:
During periods of high temperature and drought in summer, a local government advocates that farmers irrigate in the evening rather than at noon, and strictly prohibits the direct application of high-concentration chemical fertilizers during severe drought. Based on the principles of "cell water absorption and loss," and from the perspective of ensuring agricultural production and scientific participation in social affairs, answer the following questions:

(1) Combining the principle of osmosis, explain why the direct application of high-concentration chemical fertilizers during severe drought leads to "seedling burn" or even the death of crops?

(2) In clinical medicine, if a large amount of distilled water is accidentally infused into the human body, what changes will occur in red blood cells? What are the similarities and differences between this and the changes in plant cells in pure water? Please state the reasons.

(3) Regarding the social topic of "scientific fertilization," please propose two suggestions for local farmers on rational fertilization and irrigation, and elaborate on their biological basis.
questions.answer_en:
(1) After applying high-concentration chemical fertilizers, the concentration of the soil solution will be higher than that of the cell sap in the crop's root cells. According to the principle of osmosis, when the concentration of the external solution is higher than that of the cell sap, the root cells will lose water, leading to plant wilting due to water deficit, a phenomenon known as "seedling burn."
(2) Red blood cells will absorb water and burst. Similarities: Both red blood cells and plant cells absorb water, and the principle of water entering and leaving the cells is osmosis. Differences: Red blood cells lack the protection of a cell wall and will continue to expand until they burst after absorbing water; in contrast, plant cells have a fully permeable cell wall with low elasticity, which causes them to become turgid after absorbing water but generally prevents them from bursting.
(3) Recommendation 1: Timely and appropriate irrigation should be carried out after fertilization. Basis: Irrigation dilutes the soil solution and lowers its concentration, ensuring that the soil solution concentration is lower than the root cell sap concentration, which facilitates water absorption by the roots. Recommendation 2: Adhere to the principle of "frequent application of diluted fertilizer." Basis: This avoids excessively high local soil solution concentrations caused by one-time over-fertilization, prevents osmotic water loss (seedling burn), and improves fertilizer utilization efficiency.
questions.explanation_en:
The occurrence of osmosis depends on the presence of a semi-permeable membrane and the concentration gradient across it. In plant physiology, the protoplast layer of a mature plant cell acts as a selectively permeable membrane, separating the cell sap from the external solution. When the concentration of chemical fertilizers in the soil is too high, causing the water potential of the soil solution to be lower than that of the root cell sap, water flows out of the cell along the water potential gradient. This reverse migration of water not only leads to cell dehydration and wilting but also damages the structural integrity of the cell membrane and interferes with normal metabolic activities, macroscopically manifesting as physiological drought in the plant, commonly known as the "seedling burning" phenomenon.

The difference in osmotic water absorption behavior between animal and plant cells essentially stems from the varying tolerance of their cellular structures to osmotic pressure. Red blood cells are enclosed only by an extremely thin cell membrane with very low mechanical strength, making them unable to withstand the hydrostatic pressure generated by the influx of large amounts of water. In contrast, plant cell walls are primarily composed of cellulose and pectin, possessing significant rigidity and minimal elasticity. When a plant cell absorbs water, the protoplast exerts outward pressure on the cell wall, known as turgor pressure, while the cell wall generates an opposing tensile force. When these two forces reach a dynamic equilibrium, the movement of water in and out balances, protecting the cell from disintegrating due to excessive water intake; this mechanism is also key to maintaining the upright posture of herbaceous plants.

The core of scientific fertilization lies in maintaining the osmotic balance of the rhizosphere environment and the sustainability of nutrient supply. From a biological perspective, the absorption of mineral elements by the root system is an active transport process that consumes energy and is limited by carrier proteins, whereas water absorption primarily relies on osmosis. Evening irrigation effectively lowers soil temperature and reduces water evaporation, maintaining the soil solution at a lower osmotic pressure level and ensuring that plants can restore water balance through root pressure during the night. Advocating for "frequent application of diluted fertilizer" aims to control the soil solution concentration within the physiological threshold tolerable by plant receptors. This avoids osmotic damage to the root system from high salt concentrations and ensures a precise match between nutrient supply and crop growth rhythms through increased fertilization frequency, thereby achieving higher yields and efficiency.

questions.answer: 正确

questions.explanation:
植物细胞壁主要由纤维素和果胶构成，其坚韧的物理特性赋予了细胞极高的机械强度。这种结构特征在生物力学上形成了一个刚性的外壳，当细胞处于低渗环境时，水分通过渗透作用进入液泡，导致原生质体体积膨胀并对细胞壁产生向外的压力，即膨压。由于细胞壁的伸缩性极小，它能产生一个方向相反的壁压来抵消膨压，从而限制细胞的无限吸水，确保细胞在维持高张力状态的同时不会因内部压力过大而发生物理性破裂。

从进化生物学的角度来看，这种结构是植物适应陆生或淡水环境的关键机制。与缺乏细胞壁保护的动物细胞不同，植物细胞利用壁压与渗透压的动态平衡，不仅实现了在多变水分环境中的自我保护，还利用由此产生的细胞硬度（挺拔度）支撑起庞大的植株躯体。这种全透性与低伸缩性的结合，完美体现了生物体结构与功能的高度统一，是植物在长期演化过程中形成的生存策略。
questions.answer_en: Correct
questions.question_en: The cell wall of plant cells is fully permeable and possesses limited extensibility. This structural characteristic facilitates the maintenance of cell morphology in water-absorbing environments, preventing the cell from bursting due to excessive water uptake, which reflects the adaptation of biological structures to their environment.
questions.explanation_en:
Plant cell walls are primarily composed of cellulose and pectin, and their tough physical properties confer extremely high mechanical strength to the cells. This structural feature biomechanically forms a rigid shell. When a cell is in a hypotonic environment, water enters the vacuole through osmosis, causing the protoplast volume to expand and exert outward pressure on the cell wall, known as turgor pressure. Due to the minimal extensibility of the cell wall, it generates an opposing wall pressure to counteract the turgor pressure, thereby limiting the cell's unlimited water absorption and ensuring that the cell maintains a high-tension state without physical rupture due to excessive internal pressure.

From the perspective of evolutionary biology, this structure is a key mechanism for plants to adapt to terrestrial or freshwater environments. Unlike animal cells, which lack the protection of a cell wall, plant cells utilize the dynamic equilibrium between wall pressure and osmotic pressure to not only achieve self-protection in variable water environments but also use the resulting cell rigidity (turgidity) to support the large plant body. This combination of full permeability and low extensibility perfectly embodies the high degree of unity between biological structure and function, representing a survival strategy formed by plants during long-term evolution.

questions.question: 在探究植物细胞吸水和失水的实验中，研究者构建了“原生质层相当于一层半透膜”的结构模型。请结合渗透作用的条件，简述支持该模型构建的结构依据和实验证据。
questions.answer:
1. 结构依据：成熟植物细胞的细胞膜和液泡膜具有选择透过性，两层膜及之间的细胞质构成的原生质层，可看作一层将细胞液与外界溶液隔开的半透性物理屏障。
2. 实验证据：当外界溶液浓度高于细胞液浓度时，细胞通过渗透作用失水，观察到原生质层与细胞壁分离（质壁分离）；当外界溶液浓度低于细胞液浓度时，细胞通过渗透作用吸水，观察到原生质层逐渐恢复原位（质壁分离复原）。
3. 结论：由于细胞壁是全透性的，水分出入细胞的受限部位是原生质层，其实验现象符合渗透模型中半透膜的特征。

questions.explanation:
从生物物理学角度看，渗透作用的发生依赖于半透膜的存在以及膜两侧的浓度差。在成熟植物细胞中，原生质层并非单一的生物膜，而是由细胞膜、液泡膜以及两者之间的细胞质共同构成的复合结构。这一结构之所以能被抽象为“半透膜”，是因为其核心组分生物膜具有选择透过性，能够通过磷脂双分子层的疏水特性及膜蛋白的转运功能，有效限制溶质分子的自由扩散，同时允许水分子通过水通道蛋白或磷脂间隙快速进出。这种对物质通透性的差异化控制，使原生质层在功能上高度契合物理学中半透膜的定义。

实验逻辑的严密性在于通过宏观现象反推微观结构特性。当细胞处于高渗或低渗环境中时，水分子的净移动方向遵循水势梯度，而原生质层体积的收缩与扩张直接证明了其作为水分进出屏障的有效性。特别是质壁分离现象中，全透性的细胞壁与原生质层发生物理分离，这一对比有力地排除了细胞壁作为渗透屏障的可能性，从而确证了水分出入细胞的实际限制界面是原生质层。这种实验证据将复杂的生物生命活动简化为可观察、可测量的物理模型，验证了原生质层在维持细胞渗透压平衡中的核心地位。

深入分析该模型构建的科学意义，它实际上是将生物系统的复杂性进行了物理化抽象。原生质层作为半透膜的属性，不仅是静态的结构描述，更是动态的生理过程。在质壁分离与复原的循环中，原生质层的完整性和活性是实验成功的关键，这说明该“半透膜”模型具有生物活性依赖性。通过这一模型，研究者能够将细胞的水分代谢规律与物理化学中的渗透定律统一起来，为理解植物水分生理、抗逆性机制以及细胞内环境稳态提供了坚实的理论支撑。
questions.question_en: In the experiment investigating water absorption and loss in plant cells, researchers constructed a structural model stating that "the protoplast layer is equivalent to a semi-permeable membrane." In light of the conditions for osmosis, briefly state the structural basis and experimental evidence that support the construction of this model.
questions.answer_en:
1. Structural basis: The cell membrane and tonoplast of mature plant cells are selectively permeable. The protoplast, composed of these two membranes and the cytoplasm between them, can be regarded as a semi-permeable physical barrier separating the cell sap from the external solution.
2. Experimental evidence: When the concentration of the external solution is higher than that of the cell sap, the cell loses water through osmosis, and the separation of the protoplast from the cell wall (plasmolysis) is observed. When the concentration of the external solution is lower than that of the cell sap, the cell absorbs water through osmosis, and the gradual recovery of the protoplast to its original position (deplasmolysis) is observed.
3. Conclusion: Since the cell wall is fully permeable, the restricted site for water entering and leaving the cell is the protoplast. The experimental phenomena are consistent with the characteristics of a semi-permeable membrane in an osmotic model.
questions.explanation_en:
From a biophysical perspective, the occurrence of osmosis depends on the existence of a semipermeable membrane and the concentration gradient across it. In mature plant cells, the protoplast layer is not a single biological membrane but a composite structure consisting of the cell membrane, the tonoplast, and the cytoplasm between them. This structure can be abstracted as a "semipermeable membrane" because its core components, the biological membranes, possess selective permeability. Through the hydrophobic properties of the phospholipid bilayer and the transport functions of membrane proteins, it effectively restricts the free diffusion of solute molecules while allowing water molecules to pass rapidly through aquaporins or phospholipid gaps. This differential control of permeability makes the protoplast layer functionally highly consistent with the definition of a semipermeable membrane in physics.

The rigor of the experimental logic lies in inferring microscopic structural properties from macroscopic phenomena. When cells are in hypertonic or hypotonic environments, the direction of net movement of water molecules follows the water potential gradient, and the contraction and expansion of the protoplast layer's volume directly prove its effectiveness as a barrier to water entry and exit. Particularly in the phenomenon of plasmolysis, the fully permeable cell wall physically separates from the protoplast layer. This contrast effectively rules out the cell wall as an osmotic barrier, thereby confirming that the actual limiting interface for water movement in and out of the cell is the protoplast layer. This experimental evidence simplifies complex biological life activities into observable and measurable physical models, validating the central role of the protoplast layer in maintaining osmotic pressure balance.

Analyzing the scientific significance of this model construction, it is essentially a physical abstraction of the complexity of biological systems. The attribute of the protoplast layer as a semipermeable membrane is not only a static structural description but also a dynamic physiological process. In the cycle of plasmolysis and deplasmolysis, the integrity and activity of the protoplast layer are key to the success of the experiment, indicating that this "semipermeable membrane" model is bioactivity-dependent. Through this model, researchers can unify the laws of cellular water metabolism with the laws of osmosis in physical chemistry, providing a solid theoretical foundation for understanding plant water physiology, stress resistance mechanisms, and intracellular homeostasis.

questions.explanation:
从生物物理学与细胞生物学的角度审视，细胞膜与原生质层在维持细胞内外渗透平衡及物质交换中扮演着核心角色。动物细胞膜作为细胞的边界，直接与胞外环境进行物质交换；而植物细胞的原生质层由细胞膜、液泡膜以及两层膜之间的细胞质构成，在功能上被视为一个整体。这种结构上的差异并未改变其功能上的本质属性，即两者均是以磷脂双分子层为骨架、蛋白质分子贯穿其中的生物膜系统，具备调节溶质流动的物理屏障功能。

在渗透作用的物理模型中，半透膜的定义侧重于分子孔径的选择性，而生物膜的选择透过性则包含了更为复杂的生物活性调节。动物细胞膜与植物原生质层均能允许水分子自由通过，同时利用膜上的转运蛋白、离子通道等对溶质分子进行主动或被动的选择性截留。这种对溶剂与溶质渗透速率的差异化控制，使得两者在面对胞内外浓度差时，都能表现出显著的渗透压感应与调节能力，从而在宏观上呈现出一致的半透性特征。

这种功能的统一性在细胞生理活动中具有深远意义。无论是动物细胞在低渗溶液中的吸水涨破，还是植物细胞在发生质壁分离时的水分流失，其动力学过程均遵循相同的渗透规律。原生质层虽然在结构上比单一细胞膜更为复杂，但在跨膜运输与水分代谢的动态平衡中，它与动物细胞膜一样，共同构成了细胞生命活动中不可或缺的选择性屏障，确保了细胞内环境的相对稳定与稳态调节。
questions.answer_en: Correct
questions.question_en: The cell membrane of animal cells and the protoplast layer of plant cells are functionally unified, and both can be regarded as selectively permeable membranes.
questions.explanation_en:
From the perspective of biophysics and cell biology, cell membranes and the protoplast layer play a central role in maintaining osmotic balance and substance exchange between the interior and exterior of the cell. As the boundary of the cell, the animal cell membrane directly exchanges substances with the extracellular environment; meanwhile, the protoplast layer of plant cells—comprising the cell membrane, the tonoplast, and the cytoplasm between these two membranes—is functionally regarded as a single unit. This structural difference does not alter their essential functional properties: both are biomembrane systems with a phospholipid bilayer backbone and interspersed protein molecules, serving as physical barriers that regulate solute flow.

In the physical model of osmosis, the definition of a semi-permeable membrane focuses on selectivity based on molecular pore size, whereas the selective permeability of biological membranes involves more complex regulation of biological activity. Both animal cell membranes and plant protoplast layers allow water molecules to pass freely while utilizing transport proteins and ion channels to selectively intercept solute molecules through active or passive means. This differential control over the permeation rates of solvents and solutes enables both to demonstrate significant osmotic pressure sensing and regulation capabilities when faced with concentration gradients, macroscopically exhibiting consistent semi-permeable characteristics.

This functional unity holds profound significance in cellular physiological activities. Whether it is the swelling and bursting of animal cells in hypotonic solutions or the loss of water during plasmolysis in plant cells, the kinetic processes follow the same osmotic laws. Although the protoplast layer is structurally more complex than a single cell membrane, it functions identically to the animal cell membrane in the dynamic equilibrium of transmembrane transport and water metabolism. Together, they constitute the indispensable selective barriers in cellular life activities, ensuring the relative stability and homeostatic regulation of the internal environment.

questions.question: 在观察成熟植物细胞的质壁分离与复原实验中，若将洋葱表皮细胞置于一定浓度的硝酸钾溶液中，发现细胞发生了“质壁分离后自动复原”的现象。请针对这一现象提出一个科学问题，并尝试给出合理的假设。
questions.answer:
1. 科学问题：为什么洋葱表皮细胞在硝酸钾溶液中发生质壁分离后，在不更换外界溶液的情况下能自动复原？（或：硝酸钾溶液中的离子是否通过跨膜运输进入了细胞液？）
2. 合理假设：钾离子和硝酸根离子通过主动运输或协助扩散的方式进入了细胞液，导致细胞液浓度逐渐升高并超过外界溶液浓度，使细胞由失水转为吸水，从而发生自动复原。

questions.explanation:
成熟植物细胞的质壁分离与复原本质上是水分跨膜运输的宏观表现，其驱动力源于细胞液与外界溶液之间的渗透压差。在常规的蔗糖溶液实验中，由于蔗糖分子属于大分子有机物，难以穿过具有选择透过性的原生质层，因此细胞在达到渗透平衡后，若不更换低浓度溶液，无法实现自主复原。

硝酸钾溶液的特殊性在于其溶质成分为钾离子和硝酸根离子，这两种离子均是植物生长发育所必需的无机盐离子。洋葱表皮细胞的细胞膜上存在相应的离子通道和载体蛋白，能够通过协助扩散或主动运输的方式将这些离子转运至细胞内。这一生理过程打破了原有的渗透平衡，使得细胞液的溶质微粒数量动态增加。

随着离子不断进入液泡，细胞液的浓度逐渐升高，导致细胞液的渗透压反超外界溶液。当细胞液的水势低于外界溶液时，水分流动的净方向发生逆转，细胞由失水状态转为吸水状态。这种由溶质主动跨膜运输引起的渗透压动态变化，是导致细胞在不改变外界环境条件下发生“自动复原”的核心生物学机制。
questions.explanation_en:
Plasmolysis and deplasmolysis in mature plant cells are essentially macroscopic manifestations of transmembrane water transport, driven by the osmotic pressure gradient between the cell sap and the external solution. In conventional sucrose solution experiments, since sucrose molecules are large organic molecules that cannot easily pass through the selectively permeable protoplast, the cells cannot achieve autonomous recovery after reaching osmotic equilibrium unless the solution is replaced with one of lower concentration.

The uniqueness of potassium nitrate solution lies in its solute components, potassium ions and nitrate ions, both of which are essential inorganic salt ions for plant growth and development. The cell membranes of onion epidermal cells possess corresponding ion channels and carrier proteins, which can transport these ions into the cell via facilitated diffusion or active transport. This physiological process disrupts the original osmotic equilibrium, leading to a dynamic increase in the number of solute particles in the cell sap.

As ions continuously enter the vacuole, the concentration of the cell sap gradually increases, causing its osmotic pressure to eventually exceed that of the external solution. When the water potential of the cell sap becomes lower than that of the external solution, the net direction of water flow reverses, and the cell transitions from a state of water loss to a state of water absorption. This dynamic change in osmotic pressure, induced by the active transmembrane transport of solutes, is the core biological mechanism leading to the "automatic recovery" of cells without altering the external environment.
questions.answer_en:
1. Scientific Question: Why do onion epidermal cells undergo automatic recovery after plasmolysis in a potassium nitrate solution without changing the external solution? (Or: Do the ions in the potassium nitrate solution enter the cell sap through transmembrane transport?)
2. Reasonable Hypothesis: Potassium ions and nitrate ions enter the cell sap through active transport or facilitated diffusion, causing the concentration of the cell sap to gradually increase and exceed that of the external solution. This shifts the cells from water loss to water absorption, leading to automatic recovery.

questions.question: 在观察成熟植物细胞的质壁分离与复原实验中，若将洋葱鳞片叶外表皮细胞浸润在一定浓度的蔗糖溶液中，发现细胞发生了质壁分离，但随后在不改变外界溶液的情况下，细胞又自动发生了质壁分离复原。请针对这一现象提出一个合理的科学假设，并说明提出该假设的依据。
questions.answer:
1. 科学假设：外界溶液中的溶质分子（如硝酸钾、尿素、甘油等）能够通过自由扩散或协助扩散的方式进入细胞液。
2. 依据：
① 当外界溶液浓度大于细胞液浓度时，细胞渗透失水导致质壁分离；
② 若溶质分子能被细胞吸收，随着溶质进入细胞，细胞液浓度逐渐升高；
③ 当细胞液浓度反超外界溶液浓度时，细胞开始渗透吸水，从而导致质壁分离自动复原。

questions.explanation:
植物细胞的质壁分离与复原本质上是水分跨膜运输的宏观表现，其动力源于细胞液与外界溶液之间的渗透压差。在典型的质壁分离实验中，若外界溶液的溶质无法透过原生质层，细胞将维持分离状态直至达到渗透平衡。然而，当外界溶液中含有可被细胞吸收的小分子物质或离子时，实验现象会发生动态逆转。这种自动复原现象揭示了生物膜的选择透过性，即原生质层并非绝对的物理屏障，而是能够通过被动运输或主动运输调节细胞内外的溶质分布。

在实验初期，由于外界溶液浓度高于细胞液浓度，水分通过渗透作用快速流失，导致原生质体体积缩小并与细胞壁分离。与此同时，外界溶液中的溶质分子开始通过自由扩散、协助扩散或主动运输的方式进入液泡。随着溶质在细胞内的积累，细胞液的渗透压逐渐升高，而外界溶液的浓度因溶质减少和水分流失而相对降低。这一动态过程最终导致细胞内外渗透压梯度发生逆转，当细胞液浓度高于外界溶液时，水分重新进入细胞，驱动原生质体恢复原状。

这种现象的发生对溶质种类有严格要求，通常见于硝酸钾、尿素、甘油或乙二醇等溶液中。这些物质的分子直径较小或具有脂溶性，能够穿过细胞膜上的通道蛋白或磷脂双分子层。自动复原过程不仅证明了水分子的渗透方向取决于溶质梯度的动态变化，更深入地展示了活细胞具有通过改变自身渗透势来适应环境压力生理机能。若细胞失水过度导致死亡，原生质层将失去选择透过性，此时即便溶质进入也无法产生渗透压差，自动复原现象也就不会发生。
questions.explanation_en:
Plasmolysis and deplasmolysis in plant cells are essentially macroscopic manifestations of transmembrane water transport, driven by the osmotic pressure difference between the cell sap and the external solution. In a typical plasmolysis experiment, if the solutes in the external solution cannot penetrate the protoplast, the cell will remain in a state of separation until osmotic equilibrium is reached. However, when the external solution contains small molecular substances or ions that can be absorbed by the cell, the experimental phenomenon undergoes a dynamic reversal. This automatic recovery phenomenon reveals the selective permeability of biological membranes, indicating that the protoplast is not an absolute physical barrier but rather regulates the distribution of solutes inside and outside the cell through passive or active transport.

In the initial stage of the experiment, as the concentration of the external solution is higher than that of the cell sap, water is rapidly lost through osmosis, leading to the shrinkage of the protoplast and its separation from the cell wall. Simultaneously, solute molecules from the external solution begin to enter the vacuole via simple diffusion, facilitated diffusion, or active transport. As solutes accumulate within the cell, the osmotic pressure of the cell sap gradually increases, while the concentration of the external solution relatively decreases due to the reduction of solutes and the loss of water from the cell. This dynamic process eventually leads to a reversal of the osmotic pressure gradient. When the concentration of the cell sap exceeds that of the external solution, water re-enters the cell, driving the protoplast to restore its original state.

The occurrence of this phenomenon has strict requirements for the type of solute, typically observed in solutions such as potassium nitrate, urea, glycerol, or ethylene glycol. These substances have small molecular diameters or are lipid-soluble, enabling them to pass through channel proteins or the phospholipid bilayer of the cell membrane. The process of automatic recovery not only proves that the osmotic direction of water molecules depends on the dynamic changes in the solute gradient but also profoundly demonstrates the physiological mechanism of living cells to adapt to environmental stress by altering their own osmotic potential. If the cell dies due to excessive water loss, the protoplast loses its selective permeability; at this point, even if solutes enter, an osmotic pressure difference cannot be generated, and the automatic recovery phenomenon will not occur.

questions.explanation:
植物细胞的质壁分离现象深层植根于细胞结构的物理力学差异。原生质层主要由细胞膜、液泡膜及两层膜之间的细胞质组成，其本质是具有高度流动性和柔韧性的生物膜系统，表现出极强的物理形变能力。相比之下，细胞壁主要由纤维素和果胶构成，虽然具有一定的机械强度和支撑作用，但其物理结构的刚性决定了其在压力变化下的形变范围极其有限。

当细胞处于高渗环境中，水分通过渗透作用从液泡流向外界溶液，导致原生质体体积迅速收缩。由于原生质层的伸缩系数远高于细胞壁，这种体积缩减产生的向内拉力超过了细胞壁的形变极限。在这种不均匀的收缩速率下，原生质层会率先从细胞壁上剥离，从而在宏观上呈现出质壁分离的形态学特征。

这种结构上的非对称伸缩性不仅是质壁分离发生的物理前提，更是植物细胞维持渗透压平衡的一种保护机制。通过这种方式，植物能够在一定范围内感知并响应环境水分胁迫，通过调节细胞液浓度来维持基本的生理稳态，体现了生物体结构与功能、结构与环境的高度统一。

questions.question_en: During the process of plasmolysis in plant cells, because the ________________ of the protoplast is greater than that of the cell wall, the protoplast will gradually separate from the cell wall when the concentration of the cell sap is lower than that of the external solution. This structural characteristic reflects the adaptation of plant cells to changes in environmental water conditions.
questions.explanation_en:
The phenomenon of plasmolysis in plant cells is deeply rooted in the physical and mechanical differences of cellular structures. The protoplast layer, primarily composed of the cell membrane, the tonoplast, and the cytoplasm between these two membranes, is essentially a highly fluid and flexible biomembrane system that exhibits significant physical deformation capacity. In contrast, the cell wall is mainly composed of cellulose and pectin; while it provides mechanical strength and structural support, its structural rigidity dictates that its range of deformation under pressure changes is extremely limited.

When a cell is placed in a hypertonic environment, water flows from the vacuole to the external solution through osmosis, leading to a rapid contraction of the protoplast volume. Because the elasticity coefficient of the protoplast layer is much higher than that of the cell wall, the inward pulling force generated by this volume reduction exceeds the deformation limit of the cell wall. Under these uneven contraction rates, the protoplast layer detaches from the cell wall first, thereby manifesting the macroscopic morphological characteristics of plasmolysis.

This structural asymmetric extensibility is not only the physical prerequisite for the occurrence of plasmolysis but also a protective mechanism for plant cells to maintain osmotic pressure balance. In this manner, plants can perceive and respond to environmental water stress within a certain range, maintaining basic physiological homeostasis by regulating the concentration of cell sap. This reflects the high degree of unity between biological structure and function, as well as between structure and environment.

questions.question: 在观察成熟植物细胞的质壁分离与复原实验中，若将外界溶液由高浓度的蔗糖溶液更换为相同浓度的硝酸钾溶液，请你预测实验现象可能发生的变化，并提出支持该预测的科学假设。
questions.answer:
1. 预测现象：细胞先发生质壁分离，随后在不更换外界溶液的情况下自动发生质壁分离复原。
2. 科学假设：
（1）水分子的运输假设：由于外界溶液浓度高于细胞液，细胞通过渗透作用（自由扩散）失水，导致质壁分离。
（2）溶质离子的运输假设：由于细胞膜上存在相应的转运蛋白，钾离子和硝酸根离子可通过协助扩散（或主动运输）进入细胞液。
（3）浓度动态平衡假设：随着溶质离子进入细胞，细胞液浓度逐渐升高并反超外界溶液浓度，使细胞由失水转为吸水，从而实现自动复原。

questions.explanation:
植物细胞的质壁分离与复原实验本质上是探讨原生质层作为选择透过性膜对水分子及溶质分子通透性的差异。在蔗糖溶液中，由于蔗糖分子属于大分子有机物，且细胞膜上缺乏相应的载体蛋白，其无法进入细胞内部，因此细胞只能通过失水达到渗透平衡，表现为持续的质壁分离状态。

当外界溶液更换为硝酸钾时，实验的物理化学环境发生了根本性改变。硝酸根离子与钾离子作为无机小离子，能够通过细胞膜上的离子通道或载体蛋白进入细胞。这一过程打破了单纯由水分子流动主导的渗透平衡，使细胞内外的溶质分布处于动态变化之中。初始阶段，外界渗透压显著高于细胞液，水分流出的速率远超离子进入的速率，导致原生质体收缩。

随着实验时间的推移，离子在跨膜运输动力（电化学梯度或ATP水解供能）的驱动下不断积累于液泡中，使得细胞液的渗透压逐渐升高。当细胞液浓度超过外界溶液浓度时，渗透梯度的方向发生反转，水分开始重新进入细胞。这种由溶质主动或被动吸收诱发的“自动复原”现象，深刻揭示了生物膜的选择透过性不仅取决于物质的物理尺寸，更取决于膜上转运蛋白的种类与活性。

该实验现象还体现了植物细胞对逆境的一种生理调节机制。与蔗糖引起的物理性脱水不同，硝酸钾诱发的质壁分离是一个暂时的生理过程，它要求细胞必须保持生命活力以维持膜转运系统的正常运转。如果细胞死亡，膜的选择透过性丧失，则无法观察到自动复原现象。因此，这一实验常被用作鉴定细胞死活以及研究膜转运速率的重要手段。
questions.question_en: In the experiment observing the plasmolysis and deplasmolysis of mature plant cells, if the external solution is changed from a high-concentration sucrose solution to a potassium nitrate solution of the same concentration, please predict the possible changes in the experimental phenomena and propose a scientific hypothesis to support your prediction.
questions.answer_en:
1. Predicted phenomenon: The cell first undergoes plasmolysis, followed by automatic deplasmolysis without changing the external solution.
2. Scientific hypotheses:
（1）Hypothesis of water molecule transport: Since the concentration of the external solution is higher than that of the cell sap, the cell loses water through osmosis (free diffusion), leading to plasmolysis.
（2）Hypothesis of solute ion transport: Due to the presence of corresponding transport proteins on the cell membrane, potassium ions and nitrate ions can enter the cell sap through facilitated diffusion (or active transport).
（3）Hypothesis of dynamic concentration equilibrium: As solute ions enter the cell, the concentration of the cell sap gradually increases and eventually exceeds that of the external solution, causing the cell to shift from water loss to water uptake, thereby achieving automatic recovery.
questions.explanation_en:
The plasmolysis and deplasmolysis experiments of plant cells essentially explore the differences in the permeability of the protoplast, acting as a selectively permeable membrane, to water molecules and solute molecules. In a sucrose solution, since sucrose molecules are large organic molecules and the cell membrane lacks corresponding carrier proteins, they cannot enter the cell interior. Consequently, the cell can only reach osmotic equilibrium through water loss, manifesting as a sustained state of plasmolysis.

When the external solution is replaced with potassium nitrate, the physicochemical environment of the experiment undergoes a fundamental change. Nitrate ions and potassium ions, as small inorganic ions, can enter the cell through ion channels or carrier proteins on the cell membrane. This process breaks the osmotic equilibrium dominated solely by water flow, placing the solute distribution inside and outside the cell in a state of dynamic change. In the initial stage, the external osmotic pressure is significantly higher than that of the cell sap, and the rate of water efflux far exceeds the rate of ion influx, leading to the contraction of the protoplast.

As the experiment progresses, ions continuously accumulate in the vacuole, driven by transmembrane transport forces (electrochemical gradients or energy supplied by ATP hydrolysis), causing the osmotic pressure of the cell sap to gradually increase. When the concentration of the cell sap exceeds that of the external solution, the direction of the osmotic gradient reverses, and water begins to re-enter the cell. This "automatic recovery" phenomenon, induced by the active or passive absorption of solutes, profoundly reveals that the selective permeability of biological membranes depends not only on the physical size of substances but also on the types and activities of transport proteins on the membrane.

This experimental phenomenon also reflects a physiological regulation mechanism of plant cells in response to stress. Unlike the physical dehydration caused by sucrose, the plasmolysis induced by potassium nitrate is a temporary physiological process; it requires the cell to remain viable to maintain the normal operation of the membrane transport system. If the cell dies and the selective permeability of the membrane is lost, the automatic recovery phenomenon cannot be observed. Therefore, this experiment is often used as an important means to identify cell viability and study membrane transport rates.

questions.question:
在观察紫色洋葱鳞片叶外表皮细胞质壁分离与复原的实验中，某同学通过显微镜观察并测量了同一个细胞在不同浓度的蔗糖溶液中达到平衡时的状态。已知该细胞在 0.3g/mL 蔗糖溶液中发生质壁分离，此时测得细胞长轴长度（细胞壁长度）为 L，原生质体（原生质层及内部物质）的长轴长度为 W。若该细胞的 L = 100μm，在 0.3g/mL 蔗糖溶液中达到平衡时 W = 75μm；随后将该细胞置于清水中，观察到其完全复原，此时 W' = 98μm。请计算：
（1）该细胞在 0.3g/mL 蔗糖溶液中发生质壁分离时的“分离程度”（用 W/L 表示，保留两位小数）；
（2）该细胞从质壁分离状态到完全复原过程中，原生质体长度增加了多少 μm？
questions.answer:
（1）根据题意，在 0.3g/mL 蔗糖溶液中，细胞长轴长度 L = 100μm，原生质体长轴长度 W = 75μm。分离程度 W/L = 75 / 100 = 0.75。
（2）质壁分离时原生质体长度 W = 75μm，完全复原后原生质体长度 W' = 98μm。增加的长度 = W' - W = 98μm - 75μm = 23μm。
最终结果：(1) 0.75；(2) 23μm。

questions.domain_relevance_reason: 该题目紧扣高中生物教材中的核心实验“观察植物细胞的质壁分离与复原”。题目涉及洋葱鳞片叶外表皮细胞、原生质层、渗透作用等生物学核心概念，通过定量计算考察学生对细胞失水与吸水过程的理解，属于典型的生物学科知识应用题。
questions.explanation:
植物细胞的质壁分离与复原实验深刻揭示了细胞原生质层作为选择透过性膜的生物学特性。在这一过程中，细胞壁由于其主要成分纤维素和果胶的物理性质，表现出极小的伸缩性，在显微镜下其长度L可视为相对恒定的参照基准。而原生质体则是一个动态的渗透系统，其体积和长度随细胞液与外界溶液之间的渗透压差而发生显著变化。当细胞处于高渗的蔗糖溶液中时，细胞液的水势高于外界溶液，水分通过渗透作用流出，导致液泡体积缩小，原生质体随之收缩并与细胞壁分离。

W/L值作为衡量质壁分离程度的定量指标，本质上反映了细胞失水状态下原生质体缩减的比例。在0.3g/mL的蔗糖溶液中，细胞达到渗透平衡时，原生质体的长度W取决于细胞液初始渗透压与外界渗透压的差值。这一比值不仅体现了细胞的失水程度，也间接反映了细胞液的浓度范围。当W/L值越小时，说明原生质体收缩越严重，细胞失水越多。这种定量分析方法将定性的显微观察转化为定量的物理参数，是细胞生理学研究中评估细胞活力和渗透调节能力的重要手段。

从质壁分离状态转入清水中发生的复原过程，是典型的渗透吸水现象。由于清水的水势远高于细胞液，水分逆着浓度梯度进入液泡，推动原生质体向细胞壁方向扩张。在完全复原状态下，原生质体长度W'接近但通常略小于细胞壁长度L，这是因为细胞壁的刚性限制了原生质体的无限扩张，并产生静水压即膨压。膨压的产生会提高细胞液的水势，最终使细胞内外水势达到动态平衡。计算原生质体长度的变化量，能够直观地量化细胞在吸水复原过程中原生质层发生的物理位移，进而帮助理解细胞在不同渗透环境下维持稳态的调节机制。
questions.answer_en:
(1) According to the problem, in a 0.3g/mL sucrose solution, the cell long axis length L = 100μm, and the protoplast long axis length W = 75μm. The degree of separation W/L = 75 / 100 = 0.75.
(2) During plasmolysis, the protoplast length W = 75μm, and after complete recovery, the protoplast length W' = 98μm. The increased length = W' - W = 98μm - 75μm = 23μm.
Final result: (1) 0.75; (2) 23μm.
questions.explanation_en:
The experiment on plasmolysis and deplasmolysis in plant cells profoundly reveals the biological characteristics of the protoplast layer as a selectively permeable membrane. In this process, the cell wall exhibits minimal elasticity due to the physical properties of its main components, cellulose and pectin, and its length L can be regarded as a relatively constant reference baseline under the microscope. The protoplast, however, is a dynamic osmotic system whose volume and length change significantly with the osmotic pressure difference between the cell sap and the external solution. When cells are placed in a hypertonic sucrose solution, the water potential of the cell sap is higher than that of the external solution, and water flows out through osmosis, leading to a reduction in vacuole volume, causing the protoplast to shrink and separate from the cell wall.

The W/L ratio, as a quantitative indicator for measuring the degree of plasmolysis, essentially reflects the proportion of protoplast reduction under the state of cell water loss. In a 0.3 g/mL sucrose solution, when the cell reaches osmotic equilibrium, the length of the protoplast W depends on the difference between the initial osmotic pressure of the cell sap and the external osmotic pressure. This ratio not only reflects the degree of water loss but also indirectly indicates the concentration range of the cell sap. A smaller W/L ratio indicates more severe protoplast shrinkage and greater water loss. This quantitative analysis method transforms qualitative microscopic observation into quantitative physical parameters, serving as an important means in cell physiology research to evaluate cell viability and osmoregulatory capacity.

The recovery process occurring when transitioning from a state of plasmolysis into pure water is a typical osmotic water absorption phenomenon. Since the water potential of pure water is much higher than that of the cell sap, water enters the vacuole along the water potential gradient, pushing the protoplast to expand toward the cell wall. In a state of complete recovery, the protoplast length W' is close to but usually slightly smaller than the cell wall length L, because the rigidity of the cell wall limits the infinite expansion of the protoplast and generates hydrostatic pressure, namely turgor pressure. The generation of turgor pressure increases the water potential of the cell sap, eventually bringing the water potential inside and outside the cell to a dynamic equilibrium. Calculating the change in protoplast length can intuitively quantify the physical displacement of the protoplast layer during the process of water absorption and recovery, thereby helping to understand the regulatory mechanisms by which cells maintain homeostasis in different osmotic environments.

questions.question:
水资源保护与重金属污染治理是环境保护的重要课题。某些重金属离子（如汞离子 Hg²⁺）进入水体后，会与细胞膜上的水通道蛋白结合，导致蛋白质空间结构发生不可逆改变，从而影响生物体的水分代谢。请结合跨膜运输相关知识回答下列问题：
(1) 正常情况下，水分子进出肾小管上皮细胞的速率远大于通过人工脂双层的速率，原因是________________；水通道蛋白对分子的转运具有选择性，其不仅取决于通道的直径和形状，还与分子的________适宜有关。
(2) 某科研小组欲探究重金属汞污染对植物根系吸水能力的影响，将生理状态相同的某植物根部细胞分为甲、乙两组，甲组置于清水中，乙组置于含有一定浓度 HgCl₂ 的溶液中。一段时间后，将两组细胞同时移入高浓度的蔗糖溶液中。预测乙组细胞发生质壁分离的速率将________（填“显著快于”、“显著慢于”或“基本等于”）甲组，理由是________________。
(3) 结合上述材料，从“参与环境保护”的角度出发，谈谈我们在日常生活中应如何减少重金属对生物膜功能的潜在伤害，并提出一项合理的实践建议：________________。
questions.answer:
(1) 肾小管上皮细胞膜上存在水通道蛋白，水分子可以借助其进行协助扩散（或“水分子更多地以协助扩散方式进出细胞”）；电荷
(2) 显著慢于；汞离子破坏了水通道蛋白的结构，使水分通过协助扩散进出细胞的通道受阻，导致细胞失水速率下降。
(3) 意识层面：认识到重金属污染不仅破坏生态平衡，还会从分子水平损伤生物体的转运蛋白，影响生命健康。实践建议：不随意丢弃含汞电池、废旧电子产品或过期药品，应将其分类投放至有害垃圾收集点，防止重金属进入水循环和土壤系统（答案合理即可）。

questions.explanation:
水分子的跨膜运输包含自由扩散和协助扩散两种途径。人工脂双层由于缺乏蛋白质，水分子仅能通过磷脂分子的间隙以自由扩散方式通过，其速率受到疏水尾部的极大限制；而肾小管上皮细胞膜上分布有高密度的水通道蛋白，能够显著降低运输活化能，使水分以协助扩散的方式高效通过。水通道蛋白的选择性机制极为精细，除了物理层面的空间构型匹配外，通道内部特定的氨基酸残基所携带的电荷分布起到了关键的“过滤”作用，通过静电相互作用排斥带电离子，确保只有中性的水分子能够顺畅通过。

重金属离子对生物膜功能的破坏具有深层的分子机制。汞离子作为一种典型的重金属，极易与蛋白质中的巯基等官能团结合，导致多肽链的折叠方式发生改变，进而破坏水通道蛋白的特定空间结构。这种损伤是不可逆的，直接导致水通道蛋白失活或关闭。在质壁分离实验中，细胞失水的速率取决于膜对水分子的通透性，乙组细胞因水通道蛋白受损，水分外流的途径被部分阻断，仅能依靠速率较低的自由扩散，因此在宏观上表现为质壁分离速率的显著下降。

从生物学视角审视环境保护，重金属污染的危害不仅在于宏观生态系统的失衡，更在于其对生命活动基本单元——细胞膜功能的微观干扰。转运蛋白作为细胞与外界进行物质交换的门户，一旦受到重金属的结构性破坏，将直接威胁生物体的稳态调节。因此，在日常生活中实施垃圾分类，特别是对含汞电池、废旧电子元器件等有害垃圾进行专业化处理，本质上是在源头上阻断重金属进入生物圈循环，从而保护生物体内蛋白质等生物大分子的结构完整性与功能正常化。
questions.answer_en:
(1) Aquaporins exist on the membrane of renal tubular epithelial cells, through which water molecules can undergo facilitated diffusion (or "water molecules enter and exit cells more through facilitated diffusion"); charge
(2) Significantly slower than; mercury ions disrupt the structure of aquaporins, blocking the channels for water to enter and exit cells via facilitated diffusion, leading to a decrease in the rate of cellular water loss.
(3) Awareness level: Recognize that heavy metal pollution not only disrupts ecological balance but also damages transport proteins in organisms at the molecular level, affecting life and health. Practical suggestions: Do not discard mercury-containing batteries, waste electronic products, or expired medicines at will; they should be sorted and disposed of at hazardous waste collection points to prevent heavy metals from entering the water cycle and soil systems (any reasonable answer is acceptable).
questions.question_en:
Water resource protection and heavy metal pollution control are important topics in environmental protection. After certain heavy metal ions (such as mercury ions Hg²⁺) enter water bodies, they bind with aquaporins on cell membranes, leading to irreversible changes in the protein's spatial structure, thereby affecting the water metabolism of organisms. Please answer the following questions based on knowledge related to transmembrane transport:

(1) Under normal conditions, the rate of water molecules entering and leaving renal tubular epithelial cells is much higher than the rate through an artificial lipid bilayer because ________________; the transport of molecules by aquaporins is selective, which depends not only on the diameter and shape of the channel but also on the appropriate ________ of the molecules.

(2) A research team intends to investigate the effect of heavy metal mercury pollution on the water absorption capacity of plant roots. Plant root cells in the same physiological state were divided into groups A and B. Group A was placed in pure water, and Group B was placed in a solution containing a certain concentration of HgCl₂. After a period of time, both groups of cells were simultaneously moved into a high-concentration sucrose solution. It is predicted that the rate of plasmolysis in Group B cells will be ________ (fill in "significantly faster than", "significantly slower than", or "basically equal to") that of Group A, because ________________.

(3) Based on the above materials, from the perspective of "participating in environmental protection," discuss how we should reduce the potential damage of heavy metals to biomembrane functions in daily life, and propose a reasonable practical suggestion: ________________.
questions.explanation_en:
The transmembrane transport of water molecules involves two pathways: simple diffusion and facilitated diffusion. Due to the lack of proteins, water molecules can only pass through artificial lipid bilayers via simple diffusion through the gaps between phospholipid molecules, a rate significantly limited by the hydrophobic tails. In contrast, high densities of aquaporins are distributed on the renal tubular epithelial cell membrane, which can significantly reduce the activation energy of transport, allowing water to pass efficiently through facilitated diffusion. The selectivity mechanism of aquaporins is extremely precise; besides spatial configuration matching at the physical level, the charge distribution of specific amino acid residues within the channel plays a crucial "filtering" role, repelling charged ions through electrostatic interactions to ensure that only neutral water molecules can pass smoothly.

The disruption of biomembrane function by heavy metal ions involves deep molecular mechanisms. As a typical heavy metal, mercury ions readily bind with functional groups such as sulfhydryl groups in proteins, leading to changes in the folding pattern of polypeptide chains and subsequently destroying the specific spatial structure of aquaporins. This damage is irreversible, directly resulting in the inactivation or closure of aquaporins. In plasmolysis experiments, the rate of cell water loss depends on the membrane's permeability to water molecules. In Group B cells, due to damaged aquaporins, the pathway for water efflux is partially blocked, leaving them reliant only on the lower-rate simple diffusion. Consequently, this is macroscopically manifested as a significant decrease in the rate of plasmolysis.

Examining environmental protection from a biological perspective, the hazards of heavy metal pollution lie not only in the imbalance of macroscopic ecosystems but also in the microscopic interference with the functions of the cell membrane—the basic unit of life activities. As the gateway for substance exchange between the cell and its environment, transport proteins, once structurally damaged by heavy metals, will directly threaten the homeostatic regulation of the organism. Therefore, implementing waste classification in daily life, especially the professional disposal of hazardous waste such as mercury-containing batteries and waste electronic components, essentially blocks heavy metals from entering the biosphere cycle at the source, thereby protecting the structural integrity and functional normalization of biological macromolecules like proteins within organisms.

questions.question:
水资源保护与污水处理是当代环境保护的重要课题。某科研小组发现，某些工业废水中含有高浓度的重金属离子（如汞离子Hg²⁺），这些离子会诱导水通道蛋白（AQP）的结构发生不可逆改变，导致蛋白通道关闭。请结合所学知识回答下列问题：
（1）水分子进出细胞的速率受到多种因素影响。若废水中重金属离子导致水通道蛋白失活，水分子进出细胞的速率将显著______，此时水分子跨膜运输的方式主要是______。
（2）肾小管上皮细胞分布有大量的水通道蛋白。请预测，若人类长期饮用受重金属污染的水源，对尿液排出的影响是______，并从细胞水平解释其原因：____________________________________。
（3）基于通道蛋白具有“特异性”和“可调控性”的特点，请你提出一个利用生物膜技术或通道蛋白原理治理环境污染或修复生态的创新思路：____________________________________。
questions.answer:
（1）降低；自由扩散（简单扩散）。
（2）尿量增加（或多尿）；重金属离子使肾小管上皮细胞膜上的水通道蛋白失活，导致肾小管对原尿中水分的重吸收能力下降，更多水分随尿液排出。
（3）思路示例：①开发模拟水通道蛋白结构的仿生过滤膜，实现高效、低能耗的海水淡化或污水净化；②利用基因工程技术培育高表达特定离子通道蛋白的植物，用于吸收和富集土壤中的特定重金属污染物（植物修复法）；③研发针对特定毒素通道的选择性抑制剂，减少有害物质进入水生生物体内。（开放性答案，需体现参与环境保护的意识与通道蛋白原理的结合）

questions.explanation:
水分子跨膜运输存在自由扩散和协助扩散两种途径，其中通过水通道蛋白进行的协助扩散是细胞快速调节水分平衡的关键。重金属离子如汞离子具有强烈的亲硫性，能与水通道蛋白肽链上的巯基结合，诱导蛋白质空间结构发生不可逆的变性，从而封闭蛋白通道。当这一高效通道被阻断后，水分子只能依靠穿过磷脂双分子层间隙的自由扩散进出细胞，由于疏水环境的限制，这种方式的运输速率远低于协助扩散，导致细胞内外水分交换的效率大幅下降。

在人体生理调节中，肾小管和集合管上皮细胞对原尿中水分的重吸收高度依赖水通道蛋白的介导。正常生理状态下，抗利尿激素等信号分子通过调节细胞膜上水通道蛋白的数量来精确控制尿量。一旦重金属离子导致这些功能蛋白失活，肾小管上皮细胞便丧失了快速回收水分的分子基础，使得原尿中的大量水分无法被重新吸收回血液，最终导致尿液稀释并引起多尿症状。这反映了细胞水平的结构受损如何通过影响组织器官的功能，最终干扰机体的稳态平衡。

从生物工程角度看，通道蛋白的特异性源于其独特的孔径大小和电荷分布，这为精准治理环境污染提供了分子模型。仿生过滤技术通过模拟水通道蛋白的“阿加西”结构，可以在极低能耗下实现水分子的选择性通过，同时彻底拦截盐离子和有机污染物。而在生态修复领域，利用基因工程手段强化植物根系细胞膜上特定离子通道的表达，可以显著提升植物对土壤中重金属的富集效率，这种基于分子识别机制的生物修复方案，相比传统物理化学方法具有更高的环境友好性和目标针对性。
questions.question_en:
Water resource protection and wastewater treatment are important topics in contemporary environmental protection. A research team discovered that certain industrial wastewaters contain high concentrations of heavy metal ions (such as mercury ions Hg²⁺), which induce irreversible structural changes in aquaporins (AQP), leading to the closure of protein channels. Please answer the following questions based on your knowledge:

(1) The rate of water molecules entering and exiting cells is influenced by various factors. If heavy metal ions in wastewater cause the inactivation of aquaporins, the rate of water molecules entering and exiting cells will significantly ______, and the primary mode of transmembrane transport for water molecules at this time is ______.

(2) A large number of aquaporins are distributed in renal tubular epithelial cells. Predict the impact on urine excretion if humans consume heavy metal-contaminated water over a long period: ______, and explain the reason at the cellular level: ____________________________________.

(3) Based on the characteristics of "specificity" and "regulatability" of channel proteins, propose an innovative idea for environmental pollution control or ecological restoration using biomembrane technology or channel protein principles: ____________________________________.
questions.answer_en:
(1) Decrease; simple diffusion (free diffusion).
(2) Increased urine output (or polyuria); heavy metal ions inactivate the aquaporins on the renal tubular epithelial cell membrane, leading to a decrease in the reabsorption capacity of the renal tubules for water in the primary urine, resulting in more water being excreted with the urine.
(3) Example ideas: ① Develop biomimetic filtration membranes that mimic the structure of aquaporins to achieve high-efficiency, low-energy seawater desalination or wastewater purification; ② Use genetic engineering technology to cultivate plants that highly express specific ion channel proteins for the absorption and accumulation of specific heavy metal pollutants in the soil (phytoremediation); ③ Research and develop selective inhibitors for specific toxin channels to reduce the entry of harmful substances into aquatic organisms. (Open-ended answer; should reflect the integration of environmental protection awareness and the principles of channel proteins)
questions.explanation_en:
There are two pathways for the transmembrane transport of water molecules: simple diffusion and facilitated diffusion. Among them, facilitated diffusion via aquaporins is the key to the rapid regulation of cellular water balance. Heavy metal ions, such as mercury ions, possess strong thiophilicity and can bind to the sulfhydryl groups on the peptide chains of aquaporins, inducing irreversible denaturation of the protein's spatial structure and thereby blocking the protein channels. Once this highly efficient channel is obstructed, water molecules can only enter or exit the cell through simple diffusion across the gaps in the phospholipid bilayer. Due to the constraints of the hydrophobic environment, the transport rate of this mode is far lower than that of facilitated diffusion, leading to a significant decrease in the efficiency of water exchange between the interior and exterior of the cell.

In human physiological regulation, the reabsorption of water from primary urine by the epithelial cells of the renal tubules and collecting ducts is highly dependent on the mediation of aquaporins. Under normal physiological conditions, signaling molecules such as antidiuretic hormone (ADH) precisely control urine volume by regulating the number of aquaporins on the cell membrane. Once heavy metal ions cause these functional proteins to inactivate, the renal tubular epithelial cells lose the molecular basis for rapid water recovery, preventing a large amount of water in the primary urine from being reabsorbed back into the blood, ultimately leading to urine dilution and polyuria. This reflects how structural damage at the cellular level interferes with the body's homeostasis by affecting the functions of tissues and organs.

From a bioengineering perspective, the specificity of channel proteins stems from their unique pore sizes and charge distributions, providing molecular models for the precise management of environmental pollution. Biomimetic filtration technology, by simulating the "Agre" structure of aquaporins, can achieve selective passage of water molecules at extremely low energy consumption while completely intercepting salt ions and organic pollutants. In the field of ecological restoration, utilizing genetic engineering to enhance the expression of specific ion channels on plant root cell membranes can significantly improve the accumulation efficiency of heavy metals from the soil. This bioremediation solution, based on molecular recognition mechanisms, offers higher environmental friendliness and target specificity compared to traditional physical and chemical methods.

questions.question: 在维持细胞内外渗透压平衡的过程中，水分子通过协助扩散进出细胞的速率受到细胞膜上水通道蛋白数量的限制。当物质浓度梯度恒定时，由于转运蛋白具有一定的数量且转运能力有限，协助扩散的速率会表现出________________现象，这体现了细胞膜在调节物质进出以维持内环境稳态时的结构基础与功能适应。
questions.answer: 饱和
questions.subcategory: 细胞的物质输入和输出
questions.ambiguity_reason: 题目表述严谨且逻辑清晰，明确限定了“物质浓度梯度恒定”和“转运蛋白数量有限”的前提条件。在此语境下，描述协助扩散速率达到上限的生物学专业术语“饱和”具有唯一性，答案与题干高度匹配，无任何歧义。
questions.domain_relevance_reason: 该题目涉及细胞生物学的核心知识点，包括细胞膜的结构与功能、物质跨膜运输的方式（协助扩散）、水通道蛋白的作用以及内环境稳态的维持。题目考察了转运蛋白的饱和性特征，与高中生物教材中关于细胞代谢和膜转运的内容高度契合。
questions.explanation:
协助扩散的动力学特征由其物理结构基础决定。与简单扩散不同，协助扩散必须依赖细胞膜上的特异性转运蛋白（如水通道蛋白或载体蛋白）作为介质，而这些蛋白质在特定细胞膜上的分布密度和单体转运频率是有限的。在分子水平上，当膜两侧的浓度梯度较小时，转运速率主要取决于分子的碰撞频率；但随着浓度梯度的增加，参与转运的蛋白位点逐渐被趋于占满。

当所有相关的转运蛋白均处于满负荷工作状态时，单位时间内转运的分子数达到物理极限，此时即便进一步加大浓度梯度，转运速率也无法继续提升。这种动力学上的“平台期”即为饱和效应，它类同于酶促反应中的底物饱和现象，本质上反映了生物膜转运系统在处理高通量物质交换时的承载上限。

这种饱和现象不仅是物理化学规律的体现，更是细胞维持内环境稳态的一种自我保护机制。通过限制物质进出的最大速率，细胞能够缓冲外界环境剧烈波动带来的冲击，防止细胞内液渗透压或溶质浓度发生失控性改变。这种由蛋白质数量和构象转换速率共同决定的转运上限，深刻揭示了生物膜“结构决定功能”的核心原理，体现了生命系统在分子水平上对物质交换的精细调控与功能适应。
questions.answer_en: Saturation
questions.question_en: In the process of maintaining osmotic balance across the cell membrane, the rate at which water molecules enter and exit the cell through facilitated diffusion is limited by the number of aquaporins on the cell membrane. When the concentration gradient of a substance is constant, due to the finite number and limited transport capacity of transport proteins, the rate of facilitated diffusion will exhibit the phenomenon of **saturation**, which reflects the structural basis and functional adaptation of the cell membrane in regulating the movement of substances to maintain homeostasis of the internal environment.
questions.explanation_en:
The kinetic characteristics of facilitated diffusion are determined by its physical structural basis. Unlike simple diffusion, facilitated diffusion must rely on specific transport proteins on the cell membrane (such as aquaporins or carrier proteins) as mediators, and the distribution density and unit transport frequency of these proteins on a specific cell membrane are finite. At the molecular level, when the concentration gradient across the membrane is small, the transport rate primarily depends on the collision frequency of molecules; however, as the concentration gradient increases, the protein binding sites involved in transport gradually tend toward full occupancy.

When all relevant transport proteins are operating at full capacity, the number of molecules transported per unit time reaches a physical limit. At this point, even if the concentration gradient is further increased, the transport rate cannot continue to rise. This kinetic "plateau" is the saturation effect, which is analogous to substrate saturation in enzymatic reactions. It essentially reflects the capacity limit of the biological membrane transport system when handling high-throughput substance exchange.

This saturation phenomenon is not only a manifestation of physicochemical laws but also a self-protection mechanism for cells to maintain homeostasis. By limiting the maximum rate of substance entry and exit, cells can buffer the impact of drastic fluctuations in the external environment, preventing uncontrolled changes in intracellular osmotic pressure or solute concentration. This transport upper limit, jointly determined by the number of proteins and the rate of conformational change, profoundly reveals the core principle of biological membranes that "structure determines function," reflecting the fine-tuned regulation and functional adaptation of living systems at the molecular level regarding substance exchange.

questions.question:
肾脏是人体重要的排泄器官，其中肾小管和集合管对原尿中水分的重吸收主要依赖于细胞膜上的水通道蛋白（AQP2）。研究发现，若人体内抗利尿激素分泌不足或水通道蛋白结构异常，会导致尿量增加，严重时引发尿崩症。请结合所学知识回答下列问题：
（1）水分子进出肾小管上皮细胞的方式有自由扩散和协助扩散，与自由扩散相比，协助扩散的特点是____________________（答出两点）。
（2）钾离子通道蛋白只容许与自身通道直径和形状相适配、大小和电荷相适宜的离子通过，这体现了细胞膜具有____________________的功能特性。当钾离子通过通道蛋白时，________________（填“需要”或“不需要”）与通道蛋白结合。
（3）健康生活倡导：长期高盐饮食会导致血浆渗透压升高，刺激下丘脑分泌更多的抗利尿激素，促进肾小管上皮细胞膜上水通道蛋白的数量增加，从而增强对水分的重吸收。请从保护肾脏健康的角度，提出两条科学的生活习惯建议并说明理由：________________________________________________________________________。
questions.answer:
（1）需要转运蛋白（水通道蛋白）协助、运输速率更快（或：受转运蛋白数量限制）
（2）选择透过性；不需要
（3）建议一：适量饮水。理由：保证充足的水分摄入有助于维持血浆渗透压平衡，减轻肾脏调节负担。建议二：低盐饮食。理由：减少食盐摄入可降低血浆渗透压，避免抗利尿激素长期处于高水平分泌状态，预防因肾脏过度重吸收水分而产生的代谢负担，保护肾功能。

questions.explanation:
水分子的跨膜运输效率在很大程度上取决于细胞膜上水通道蛋白的丰度。自由扩散受磷脂双分子层疏水性的限制，其转运速率较低且仅受浓度梯度驱动；而协助扩散通过特异性通道蛋白降低了跨膜阻力，不仅显著提高了水分子的渗透速率，还表现出明显的饱和效应，即转运速率会受到膜上通道蛋白数量的限制。这种高效的转运机制是肾脏在短时间内完成大量原尿重吸收的物理化学基础。

通道蛋白的特异性是由其高度精确的分子结构决定的。以钾离子通道为例，其内部的氨基酸残基形成了特定的选择性过滤器，能够通过静电相互作用和空间匹配精确识别脱水后的钾离子。这种对溶质分子的严苛筛选体现了生物膜在维持细胞内外离子稳态时的选择透过性。与载体蛋白不同，通道蛋白在转运过程中并不与溶质分子发生特异性结合，而是提供一个贯穿膜的亲水性孔道，使离子能够顺电化学梯度快速通过，这种机制保证了离子流动的极高通量。

人体水分平衡的调节是一个复杂的神经-体液调节过程。当机体摄入过量盐分时，血浆渗透压的升高会激活下丘脑的渗透压感受器，通过下丘脑-垂体系统释放抗利尿激素，进而诱导肾小管上皮细胞胞质内的AQP2囊泡向顶端膜转移并融合。长期高盐饮食会导致这一调节机制处于高负荷运转状态，增加肾脏的代谢压力。因此，通过低盐饮食减少溶质负荷，以及适量饮水维持正常的血浆渗透压，能够有效降低抗利尿激素的代偿性分泌，减轻肾小管重吸收水分的负担，从源头上预防肾功能受损，维护内环境的稳态。
questions.question_en:
The kidneys are important excretory organs of the human body, in which the reabsorption of water from primary urine by renal tubules and collecting ducts mainly depends on aquaporins (AQP2) on the cell membrane. Research has found that if the secretion of antidiuretic hormone in the human body is insufficient or the structure of aquaporins is abnormal, it will lead to an increase in urine volume, causing diabetes insipidus in severe cases. Please answer the following questions based on your knowledge:

(1) The ways water molecules enter and exit renal tubular epithelial cells include simple diffusion and facilitated diffusion. Compared with simple diffusion, the characteristics of facilitated diffusion are ____________________ (state two points).

(2) Potassium ion channel proteins only allow ions that match their own channel diameter and shape, and have appropriate size and charge to pass through, which reflects that the cell membrane has the functional characteristic of ____________________. When potassium ions pass through the channel protein, they ________________ (fill in "need" or "do not need") to bind with the channel protein.

(3) Healthy living advocacy: A long-term high-salt diet will lead to an increase in plasma osmotic pressure, stimulating the hypothalamus to secrete more antidiuretic hormone and promoting an increase in the number of aquaporins on the renal tubular epithelial cell membrane, thereby enhancing the reabsorption of water. From the perspective of protecting kidney health, please propose two scientific lifestyle suggestions and explain the reasons: ________________________________________________________________________.
questions.explanation_en:
The transmembrane transport efficiency of water molecules depends largely on the abundance of aquaporins on the cell membrane. Simple diffusion is limited by the hydrophobicity of the phospholipid bilayer, resulting in a low transport rate driven solely by concentration gradients. In contrast, facilitated diffusion reduces transmembrane resistance through specific channel proteins, which not only significantly increases the osmotic rate of water molecules but also exhibits a distinct saturation effect, meaning the transport rate is limited by the number of channel proteins on the membrane. This efficient transport mechanism provides the physicochemical basis for the kidneys to complete the reabsorption of a large volume of primary urine within a short period.

The specificity of channel proteins is determined by their highly precise molecular structures. Taking potassium ion channels as an example, the internal amino acid residues form a specific selectivity filter that accurately recognizes dehydrated potassium ions through electrostatic interactions and steric matching. This rigorous screening of solute molecules reflects the selective permeability of biological membranes in maintaining ion homeostasis between the intracellular and extracellular environments. Unlike carrier proteins, channel proteins do not bind specifically to solute molecules during transport; instead, they provide a hydrophilic pore spanning the membrane, allowing ions to pass rapidly along their electrochemical gradients. This mechanism ensures an extremely high flux of ion flow.

The regulation of water balance in the human body is a complex neuro-humoral process. When the body ingests excessive salt, the rise in plasma osmotic pressure activates hypothalamic osmoreceptors, which release antidiuretic hormone (ADH) via the hypothalamic-pituitary system. This, in turn, induces the translocation and fusion of AQP2 vesicles within the cytoplasm of renal tubular epithelial cells to the apical membrane. A long-term high-salt diet keeps this regulatory mechanism in a high-load state, increasing the metabolic pressure on the kidneys. Therefore, reducing solute load through a low-salt diet and maintaining normal plasma osmotic pressure through adequate water intake can effectively reduce the compensatory secretion of ADH, alleviate the burden of water reabsorption in the renal tubules, prevent renal function impairment at its source, and maintain the homeostasis of the internal environment.
questions.answer_en:
(1) Requires the assistance of transport proteins (aquaporins); the transport rate is faster (or: limited by the number of transport proteins).
(2) Selective permeability; not required.
(3) Suggestion 1: Drink an appropriate amount of water. Reason: Ensuring adequate water intake helps maintain the balance of plasma osmotic pressure and reduces the regulatory burden on the kidneys. Suggestion 2: Low-salt diet. Reason: Reducing salt intake can lower plasma osmotic pressure, preventing antidiuretic hormone (ADH) from being secreted at high levels for prolonged periods, avoiding the metabolic burden caused by excessive water reabsorption by the kidneys, and protecting renal function.

questions.question:
水分子进出细胞主要通过水通道蛋白完成。研究发现，肾小管上皮细胞膜上的水通道蛋白（AQP2）在调节尿液浓度中起关键作用。当人体缺水时，抗利尿激素增加，促进含有AQP2的囊泡与细胞膜融合；而在某些病理状态下，水通道蛋白的功能异常会导致多尿或水肿。请结合所学知识回答下列问题：
（1）从蛋白质结构与功能的角度，解释为什么水通道蛋白只容许水分子通过，而钾离子、钠离子等较小的离子却不能通过？
（2）与自由扩散相比，协助扩散在维持细胞水分代谢平衡方面具有哪些生理优势？请进行理性判断并说明理由。
（3）若利用人工脂双层膜（不含蛋白质）模拟肾小管上皮细胞的重吸收功能，其实验结果与真实生理状态会有显著差异。请预测该差异并从物质运输速率的影响因素角度解释原因。
questions.answer:
（1）①通道蛋白具有特异性。水通道蛋白的直径和形状与水分子适配，且其内部的电荷分布与水分子相适宜。②离子虽然体积小，但带有电荷，且其直径、形状及电荷属性与水通道蛋白不匹配，因此无法通过。
（2）①高效性：协助扩散的速率远大于自由扩散，能满足特定组织细胞（如肾小管）快速转运水分的需求。②可调节性：细胞可以通过调节膜上转运蛋白的数量或开关状态来精确控制水分的运输速率，而自由扩散主要受浓度梯度影响，缺乏生物调节的灵活性。
（3）差异：人工膜的水分转运速率将远低于真实生理状态下的速率。原因：①自由扩散的速率仅取决于膜内外物质浓度梯度的大小；②协助扩散的速率不仅受浓度梯度影响，还与转运蛋白的数量有关。肾小管上皮细胞膜上含有大量水通道蛋白，极大地提高了水分重吸收的效率，而人工膜缺乏此类蛋白。

questions.explanation:
水通道蛋白的特异性源于其精密的分子构象与电荷排布。其孔径的物理尺寸在最窄处仅略大于水分子，形成了严苛的物理屏障；更核心的选择性机制在于孔道内部存在特定的氨基酸残基（如精氨酸和组氨酸），它们形成的强静电场能有效排斥带正电荷的离子。此外，水通道内的偶极相互作用迫使水分子以特定的取向单行排列通过，这种“分子筛”效应不仅排除了体积较大的溶质，也通过电荷排斥彻底阻断了即便体积更小的离子流，确保了水分运输的高度纯净与定向。

协助扩散在生理调节中的优越性体现为跨膜转运的“高通量”与“可控性”。相比于受限于磷脂双分子层疏水核心屏障作用的自由扩散，水通道蛋白提供了低活化能的亲水通道，使水分重吸收速率在短时间内提升数个数量级，这对于维持内环境渗透压的稳态至关重要。更重要的是，这种方式赋予了细胞对环境变化的动态响应能力，通过抗利尿激素等信号转导途径，细胞可以迅速改变膜上AQP2的丰度或构型，实现了从被动渗透向精准调节的跨越，这是生命体应对缺水等应激状态的进化选择。

人工脂双层与生物膜在功能上的显著差异，本质上是物质运输动力学受限的结果。在缺乏转运蛋白的系统中，水分子的跨膜阻力主要来自磷脂脂肪酸链的疏水作用，其渗透系数极低，仅能依靠极慢的自由扩散进行。而在真实的肾小管上皮细胞中，AQP2的存在将物质运输从单纯的浓度梯度驱动转变为“梯度驱动+载体介导”的双重机制。这种蛋白质介导的转运具有极高的转运速率，使得机体能在极短时间内完成大量的原尿重吸收，从而有效浓缩尿液，这是单纯物理化学过程无法企及的生物学效能。
questions.answer_en:
(1) ① Channel proteins exhibit specificity. The diameter and shape of aquaporins match water molecules, and their internal charge distribution is compatible with water molecules. ② Although ions are small, they carry charges, and their diameter, shape, and charge properties do not match aquaporins; therefore, they cannot pass through.

(2) ① High efficiency: The rate of facilitated diffusion is much higher than that of simple diffusion, meeting the demand for rapid water transport in specific tissue cells (such as renal tubules). ② Regulability: Cells can precisely control the rate of water transport by regulating the number or the gating state of transport proteins on the membrane, whereas simple diffusion is primarily influenced by concentration gradients and lacks the flexibility of biological regulation.

(3) Difference: The water transport rate of artificial membranes will be much lower than the rate under real physiological conditions. Reason: ① The rate of simple diffusion depends solely on the magnitude of the concentration gradient across the membrane; ② The rate of facilitated diffusion is affected not only by the concentration gradient but also by the number of transport proteins. The membranes of renal tubular epithelial cells contain a large number of aquaporins, which greatly enhances the efficiency of water reabsorption, whereas artificial membranes lack such proteins.
questions.explanation_en:
The specificity of aquaporins stems from their precise molecular conformation and charge distribution. The physical size of the pore at its narrowest point is only slightly larger than a water molecule, forming a strict physical barrier. The core selectivity mechanism lies in specific amino acid residues (such as arginine and histidine) within the pore, which create a strong electrostatic field that effectively repels positively charged ions. Furthermore, dipole interactions within the channel force water molecules to pass through in a single-file orientation. This "molecular sieve" effect not only excludes larger solutes but also completely blocks even smaller ion fluxes through charge repulsion, ensuring highly pure and directional water transport.

The superiority of facilitated diffusion in physiological regulation is reflected in the "high throughput" and "controllability" of transmembrane transport. Compared to simple diffusion, which is limited by the hydrophobic core barrier of the phospholipid bilayer, aquaporins provide hydrophilic channels with low activation energy, increasing the rate of water reabsorption by several orders of magnitude in a short period. This is crucial for maintaining the homeostasis of internal osmotic pressure. More importantly, this mechanism grants cells the ability to respond dynamically to environmental changes. Through signal transduction pathways such as antidiuretic hormone (ADH), cells can rapidly alter the abundance or configuration of AQP2 on the membrane, achieving a leap from passive osmosis to precise regulation—an evolutionary choice for organisms to cope with stress states like dehydration.

The significant functional difference between artificial lipid bilayers and biological membranes is essentially a result of limited transport kinetics. In systems lacking transport proteins, the transmembrane resistance for water molecules primarily comes from the hydrophobic effect of phospholipid fatty acid chains, resulting in an extremely low permeability coefficient that relies solely on very slow simple diffusion. In actual renal tubular epithelial cells, the presence of AQP2 transforms transport from a purely concentration gradient-driven process into a dual mechanism of "gradient-driven + protein-mediated" transport. This protein-mediated transport possesses an extremely high rate, allowing the body to complete a large amount of primary urine reabsorption in a very short time to effectively concentrate urine—a biological efficiency unattainable by purely physicochemical processes.
questions.question_en:
Water molecules enter and exit cells primarily through aquaporins. Research has found that aquaporin-2 (AQP2) on the membrane of renal tubular epithelial cells plays a key role in regulating urine concentration. When the human body is dehydrated, the increase in antidiuretic hormone promotes the fusion of vesicles containing AQP2 with the cell membrane; in certain pathological states, abnormal function of aquaporins can lead to polyuria or edema. Please answer the following questions based on your knowledge:

(1) From the perspective of protein structure and function, explain why aquaporins only allow water molecules to pass through, while smaller ions such as potassium ions and sodium ions cannot?
(2) Compared with simple diffusion, what are the physiological advantages of facilitated diffusion in maintaining cellular water metabolism balance? Please make a rational judgment and explain the reasons.
(3) If an artificial lipid bilayer (without proteins) is used to simulate the reabsorption function of renal tubular epithelial cells, the experimental results will differ significantly from the actual physiological state. Please predict this difference and explain the reasons from the perspective of factors affecting the rate of substance transport.

questions.question: 请结合主动运输的过程，构建一个关于主动运输基本要素及其逻辑关系的结构模型，并说明该运输方式对维持细胞生命活动的意义。
questions.answer:
1. 结构模型要素：主动运输模型应包含转运方向（逆浓度梯度）、转运蛋白（载体蛋白）、能量消耗（ATP水解供能）三个核心要素。
2. 逻辑关系：物质首先与载体蛋白特定部位结合，在ATP水解释放能量的推动下，载体蛋白空间结构发生改变，将物质转运至膜另一侧并释放，随后载体蛋白恢复原状。
3. 生命活动意义：主动运输使细胞能够根据生命活动的需要，主动选择吸收营养物质，排出代谢废物和有害物质，从而保证细胞内部环境的相对稳定和各项生命活动的正常进行。

questions.explanation:
从热力学角度看，主动运输是一个逆熵增的过程，其本质是将放能反应（如ATP的水解）与吸能的跨膜转运过程相偶联。这种偶联机制打破了物质扩散的自发性，使得细胞能够克服化学势能或电位能的阻碍，实现特定分子或离子在膜两侧的非平衡分布。这种非平衡态的维持是生命系统有序性的重要体现，也是细胞进行复杂代谢活动的基础。

在分子水平上，载体蛋白作为一种高度特异性的分子机器，其构象转换是主动运输的核心逻辑。当转运底物与载体蛋白的特定结合位点结合后，ATP分子的磷酸化作用或能量释放会诱导蛋白质发生变构效应。这种构象的变化改变了结合位点对底物的亲和力，并使底物暴露于膜的另一侧。随后，随着磷酸基团的脱落或能量状态的恢复，载体蛋白回归初始构象，完成一个完整的转运循环。这种精准的分子开关机制确保了物质转运的高效性与方向性。

主动运输的生物学意义远超物质积累本身，它是细胞维持稳态的核心手段。通过主动运输建立的跨膜离子梯度（如钠钾泵维持的离子浓度差），不仅为细胞提供了渗透压调节的手段，还为继发性主动运输提供了势能储备，更是神经传导、肌肉收缩等生理过程的能量基础。这种对内环境的高度掌控力，使细胞能够摆脱对外界环境浓度的依赖，在多变的生存环境中保持代谢的独立性和连续性，从而支撑起复杂的生命演化进程。
questions.question_en: Based on the process of active transport, construct a structural model of the essential elements and their logical relationships in active transport, and explain the significance of this transport mode for maintaining cellular life activities.
questions.answer_en:
1. Structural Model Elements: The active transport model should include three core elements: transport direction (against the concentration gradient), transport protein (carrier protein), and energy consumption (energy supplied by ATP hydrolysis).
2. Logical Relationship: The substance first binds to a specific site on the carrier protein. Driven by the energy released from ATP hydrolysis, the spatial structure of the carrier protein undergoes a conformational change, transporting the substance to the other side of the membrane and releasing it, after which the carrier protein returns to its original state.
3. Significance for Life Activities: Active transport enables cells to actively select and absorb nutrients and excrete metabolic wastes and harmful substances according to the needs of life activities, thereby ensuring the relative stability of the cell's internal environment and the normal progression of various life activities.
questions.explanation_en:
From a thermodynamic perspective, active transport is a process that opposes the increase of entropy. Its essence lies in coupling exergonic reactions (such as ATP hydrolysis) with endergonic transmembrane transport processes. This coupling mechanism breaks the spontaneity of substance diffusion, enabling cells to overcome barriers of chemical or electrical potential to achieve a non-equilibrium distribution of specific molecules or ions across the membrane. The maintenance of this non-equilibrium state is a vital manifestation of the orderliness of biological systems and serves as the foundation for complex metabolic activities.

At the molecular level, carrier proteins function as highly specific molecular machines, with their conformational transition being the core logic of active transport. When a transport substrate binds to a specific site on the carrier protein, the phosphorylation of ATP or the release of energy induces an allosteric effect in the protein. This conformational change alters the affinity of the binding site for the substrate and exposes the substrate to the other side of the membrane. Subsequently, as the phosphate group is released or the energy state is restored, the carrier protein returns to its initial conformation, completing a full transport cycle. This precise molecular switch mechanism ensures the efficiency and directionality of substance transport.

The biological significance of active transport extends far beyond substance accumulation itself; it is the core means by which cells maintain homeostasis. Transmembrane ion gradients established through active transport (such as the ion concentration differences maintained by the sodium-potassium pump) not only provide a means for osmotic pressure regulation but also serve as potential energy reserves for secondary active transport. Furthermore, they form the energetic basis for physiological processes such as nerve conduction and muscle contraction. This high degree of control over the internal environment allows cells to transcend dependence on external concentrations, maintaining metabolic independence and continuity in fluctuating environments, thereby supporting the complex evolutionary process of life.

questions.question: 已知甲状腺滤泡上皮细胞内碘浓度比血液高20~25倍，且该细胞能持续从血液中吸收碘。请依据主动运输的原理，推论该吸收过程必须具备的两个基本条件，并解释主动运输对细胞生命活动的意义。
questions.answer:
条件：
1. 需要载体蛋白的协助：碘离子必须与细胞膜上特定载体蛋白结合，通过其空间结构的变化实现转运。
2. 需要消耗能量：逆浓度梯度运输属于“逆水行舟”，必须由细胞呼吸释放的能量（如ATP）驱动。

意义：
主动运输保证了细胞能根据生命活动的需要，主动选择吸收所需要的营养物质，排出代谢废物和有害物质，从而维持细胞内环境的稳定。

questions.explanation:
从生物物理学角度看，逆浓度梯度的跨膜转运本质上是一个熵减过程，必须通过耦合放能反应来克服热力学阻力。甲状腺滤泡上皮细胞膜上的钠-碘同向转运体（NIS）利用钠钾泵维持的电化学梯度或直接消耗ATP，驱动碘离子逆着巨大的浓度差向胞内聚集。这种转运依赖于膜蛋白构象的特异性改变，载体蛋白通过与配体的选择性结合，在能量驱动下发生变构，从而将溶质分子从低浓度侧定向输送至高浓度侧。

主动运输的生理价值在于其赋予了细胞高度的自主调控能力，使其摆脱了对外部环境浓度的被动依赖。通过这种耗能的精准筛选机制，细胞能够打破物理扩散带来的平衡态，建立并维持一种非平衡的稳态。这种稳态不仅是合成甲状腺激素等特定生化反应的前提，更是细胞维持正常渗透压、酸碱缓冲体系以及信号传导的基础，体现了生命系统作为开放系统通过摄取负熵来维持高度有序性的本质特征。

这种选择性积聚与排泄机制，构筑了细胞膜作为“生命屏障”的核心功能。它确保了关键代谢底物在胞内的富集，同时能迅速将代谢副产物或潜在毒素泵出胞外，从而在多变的内环境中为复杂的酶促反应提供恒定的生化反应器。这种对物质流动的精细掌控，是多细胞生物实现细胞分化与功能特化的物质基础，也是生命体区别于非生命物质的关键标志之一。
questions.question_en: It is known that the iodine concentration within thyroid follicular epithelial cells is 20–25 times higher than that in the blood, and these cells can continuously absorb iodine from the blood. Based on the principles of active transport, deduce the two essential conditions required for this absorption process and explain the significance of active transport for cellular life activities.
questions.answer_en:
Conditions:
1. Requirement for carrier proteins: Iodide ions must bind to specific carrier proteins on the cell membrane, and transport is achieved through changes in their conformational structure.
2. Requirement for energy consumption: Transport against the concentration gradient is akin to "rowing against the current" and must be driven by energy released from cellular respiration (such as ATP).

Significance:
Active transport ensures that cells can actively select and absorb necessary nutrients and expel metabolic wastes and harmful substances according to the needs of life activities, thereby maintaining the stability of the internal environment.
questions.explanation_en:
From a biophysical perspective, transmembrane transport against a concentration gradient is essentially an entropy-decreasing process that must overcome thermodynamic resistance by coupling with exergonic reactions. The sodium-iodide symporter (NIS) on the membrane of thyroid follicular epithelial cells utilizes the electrochemical gradient maintained by the sodium-potassium pump or directly consumes ATP to drive the intracellular accumulation of iodide ions against a massive concentration gradient. This transport relies on specific conformational changes of membrane proteins; carrier proteins undergo energy-driven allosteric transitions through selective binding with ligands, thereby directionally transporting solute molecules from the low-concentration side to the high-concentration side.

The physiological value of active transport lies in the high degree of autonomous regulatory capacity it confers upon the cell, freeing it from passive dependence on external environmental concentrations. Through this energy-consuming, precise screening mechanism, cells can break the equilibrium state brought about by physical diffusion, establishing and maintaining a non-equilibrium steady state. This steady state is not only a prerequisite for specific biochemical reactions such as thyroid hormone synthesis but also the foundation for maintaining normal osmotic pressure, acid-base buffering systems, and signal transduction, reflecting the essential characteristic of living systems as open systems that maintain high order by importing negative entropy.

This mechanism of selective accumulation and excretion constructs the core function of the cell membrane as a "biological barrier." It ensures the intracellular enrichment of key metabolic substrates while rapidly pumping metabolic by-products or potential toxins out of the cell, thereby providing a constant biochemical reactor for complex enzymatic reactions within a variable internal environment. This precise control over material flow is the material basis for cell differentiation and functional specialization in multicellular organisms, and it is one of the key hallmarks distinguishing living organisms from non-living matter.

questions.question:
甲状腺滤泡上皮细胞内碘浓度比血液高20~25倍，但仍能不断吸收碘。下列关于该生理过程的叙述，体现了“物质与能量观”的是：
A. 碘离子通过离子通道顺浓度梯度进入细胞
B. 细胞通过主动运输吸收碘，该过程需要载体蛋白协助并消耗能量
C. 碘离子的吸收速率仅取决于细胞膜外碘离子的浓度
D. 细胞膜上的磷脂双分子层为碘离子的吸收提供了能量

questions.explanation:
碘离子在甲状腺滤泡上皮细胞内的逆浓度梯度积累，本质上是一个跨膜做功的过程。在生物膜系统中，这种逆浓度梯度的物质转运无法通过简单的物理扩散或协助扩散实现，必须依赖特定的载体蛋白作为分子泵。这一过程打破了热力学第二定律在无生命系统中的自发趋势，体现了生命系统通过有序的结构来实现对物质分布的精准调控。

从能量转化的角度看，主动运输是细胞代谢能与跨膜势能之间的转换。细胞通过水解ATP直接供能，或利用离子梯度产生的电化学势能，驱动载体蛋白发生构象改变，从而将碘离子从低浓度的胞外环境强制转运至高浓度的胞内。这种物质的定向移动以能量的消耗为代价，深刻诠释了生命活动中物质循环与能量流动的内在统一性，是维持细胞特定生理功能的能量基础。

物质转运的效率并非仅受胞外浓度影响，而是受到细胞膜上载体蛋白的数量、活性以及细胞呼吸产生的能量供应水平的多重制约。磷脂双分子层作为疏水性屏障，构成了细胞的基本骨架并阻止了离子的自由扩散，但其本身并不直接提供驱动力。这种基于分子结构的能量耦合过程，不仅是细胞吸收营养物质的必要手段，更是生命体表现出高度有序特征和动态平衡的物质保障。
questions.answer_en: B
questions.explanation_en:
The accumulation of iodide ions against the concentration gradient within thyroid follicular epithelial cells is essentially a process of transmembrane work. In biological membrane systems, such substance transport against a concentration gradient cannot be achieved through simple physical diffusion or facilitated diffusion; it must rely on specific carrier proteins acting as molecular pumps. This process breaks the spontaneous tendency of the Second Law of Thermodynamics in non-living systems, reflecting how living systems achieve precise regulation of substance distribution through ordered structures.

From the perspective of energy transformation, active transport is the conversion between cellular metabolic energy and transmembrane potential energy. Cells provide energy directly through ATP hydrolysis or utilize the electrochemical potential energy generated by ion gradients to drive conformational changes in carrier proteins, thereby forcibly transporting iodide ions from the low-concentration extracellular environment to the high-concentration intracellular space. This directional movement of substances comes at the cost of energy consumption, profoundly interpreting the inherent unity of material cycling and energy flow in life activities, and serving as the energetic basis for maintaining specific physiological functions of the cell.

The efficiency of substance transport is not solely influenced by extracellular concentration but is constrained by multiple factors, including the number and activity of carrier proteins on the cell membrane and the level of energy supply generated by cellular respiration. The phospholipid bilayer, as a hydrophobic barrier, constitutes the basic framework of the cell and prevents the free diffusion of ions, but it does not directly provide the driving force. This energy coupling process based on molecular structure is not only a necessary means for cells to absorb nutrients but also the material guarantee for living organisms to exhibit highly ordered characteristics and dynamic equilibrium.
questions.question_en:
The iodine concentration within thyroid follicular epithelial cells is 20–25 times higher than that in the blood, yet they can still continuously absorb iodine. Which of the following descriptions regarding this physiological process reflects the "concept of matter and energy"?
A. Iodine ions enter the cell through ion channels along the concentration gradient.
B. Cells absorb iodine through active transport, a process that requires the assistance of carrier proteins and consumes energy.
C. The absorption rate of iodine ions depends solely on the concentration of iodine ions outside the cell membrane.
D. The phospholipid bilayer on the cell membrane provides energy for the absorption of iodine ions.
questions.question_fr: A. Les ions iodure pénètrent dans la cellule par des canaux ioniques suivant le gradient de concentration. B. La cellule absorbe l'iode par transport actif, un processus qui nécessite des protéines de transport et consomme de l'énergie. C. La vitesse d'absorption des ions iodure dépend uniquement de leur concentration à l'extérieur de la cellule. D. La bicouche phospholipidique de la membrane cellulaire fournit l'énergie nécessaire à l'absorption des ions iodure.

questions.answer: 正确
